proposed_fixes.title: FancyZones editor cannot save an exact 1600 px zone boundary
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The editor may distribute integer pixels across adjacent zones, producing a 1599/1601 split when the drag boundary is snapped or rounded.
plan: Trace zone-boundary coordinate conversion and snapping for a 2560-pixel monitor with the reported two-zone layout.
Preserve exact integer widths when the user enters or drags a representable boundary, accounting for gaps and scaling.
Add a layout-editor test for the exact 1600-pixel split and adjacent zone totals.
verification: Create a two-column 2560×1440 layout and verify the selected zone can be set to exactly 1600 px without drifting after mouse release.

confidence.rationale: Coordinate rounding or snap-distance constraint is plausible; current editor behavior is unverified.
